## Schedule

The event will be held at the Q-Center (MBH 202) and will start on April 18th. Notable times are provided below.

### Saturday 04/18

- **Opening ceremony**: 10:00 am - 10:30 am. Snacks will be provided during the opening ceremony.

- **Work hours**: 10:30 am - late. Groups are encouraged to stay in Bi Hall and work on their projects. 

### Sunday 04/19

- **Work hours**: 8:00 am - 11:45 am. Groups are encouraged to stay in Bi Hall and work on their projects. 

- **Presentations**: 12:00 pm - 1:30 pm. Groups will be given 5 minutes to present their findings to a panel of judges. Locations TBD.

- **Closing ceremony**: 1:30 pm - 2:00 pm. Closing thoughts and awards.
